shortDescription: config the next restart file or ipe .   patch function not available,please use patch module

options.name: boot
options.description: File (including abs path) of the local boot package (.bin)

options.name: delete_ipe
options.description: If ipe_package is used, this specifies whether the .ipe file is deleted from the device after it is unpacked.

options.name: filename
options.description: Name of file that will be show content.

options.name: ipe_package
options.description: File (including abs path path) of the local ipe package.

options.name: nextstartupfile
options.description: Name of file that will be used for the next start.

options.name: patch
options.description: File (including abs path) of the local patch package (.bin)

options.name: show_file
options.description: File that will be used to store the config file content.  Relative path is location of ansible playbook. If not set, no file saved.

options.name: system
options.description: File (including abs path) of the local system package (.bin)
